import os
import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool
TRACKING_SERVER_URL = os.environ.get('TRACKING_SERVER_URL', 'http://localhost:5000')
TRACKING_SERVER_TOKEN = os.environ.get('TRACKING_SERVER_TOKEN', '')

@tool
def grant_experiment_access(experiment_id: str, user_email: str, role: str) -> str:
    allowed_role_names_for_experiments = {'viewer', 'editor', 'admin'}
    normalized_role_name_requested = role.strip().lower()
    if normalized_role_name_requested not in allowed_role_names_for_experiments:
        return f"Invalid role '{role}'. Choose from {sorted(allowed_role_names_for_experiments)}."
    # Clear any pending access requests from this user for the experiment
    pending_requests_cleanup_response = requests.delete(
        f'{TRACKING_SERVER_URL}/api/2.0/experiments/{experiment_id}/access-requests',
        params={'user': user_email},
        headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {TRACKING_SERVER_TOKEN}'},
        timeout=30,
    )
    pending_requests_cleanup_response.raise_for_status()
    permission_update_endpoint_url = f'{TRACKING_SERVER_URL}/api/2.0/experiments/{experiment_id}/permissions'
    authorization_headers_for_request = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {TRACKING_SERVER_TOKEN}'}
    permission_update_payload = {'user': user_email, 'role': normalized_role_name_requested}
    permission_update_response = requests.put(permission_update_endpoint_url, json=permission_update_payload, headers=authorization_headers_for_request, timeout=30)
    permission_update_response.raise_for_status()
    return f'{user_email} now has role {normalized_role_name_requested} on experiment {experiment_id}.'
